thread:
alex: Heads-up — we have a multi-region onboarding throttle affecting a small percentage of EU & APAC tenants. SRE estimates ~2h to fully clear. Drafting a customer status + mini-RCA now.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the short exec summary we should send to high-touch accounts? they want plain language.

alex: Sure. Exec summary draft: 'We experienced intermittent onboarding delays for new tenant webhooks in EU and APAC between 08:10–09:05 UTC. The root cause was a burst of parallel provisioning requests that triggered an autoscaler race and transient auth timeouts. We’ve implemented a hotfix to stabilize scaling and are monitoring. No data was lost. We will follow up with an RCA and targeted mitigation credits.'

raj: +1. For renewal-risk customers include offer: one week of priority support credits + a 10% usage credit for impacted onboarding tokens.

emily: Can we get this translated to FR/DE/JA? CS ops can't rely on machine-only for sensitive wording. I'll loop in localization.

alex: tagging localization: @emily — thanks. Also need a short FAQ for CS reps: 1) Why did this happen? 2) Who was impacted? 3) What to tell customers now?

maria: Draft FAQ bullets: 'Why — autoscaler race under burst provisioning. Who — ~0.6% of onboarding webhooks initiated between 08:10–08:55 UTC in eu-west-1 & ap-northeast-1. What to tell customers — we fixed the scaling logic, affected tenants will continue onboarding; if a tenant still sees failures, open a ticket and we'll prioritize.'

emily: Suggest adding 'How are we preventing recurrence' bullet: 'tightened provisioning concurrency limits, added a short jitter, and improved alerting for scaled-up activity.'

raj: For the mini-RCA note we should include the immediate mitigation timeline and owner. I propose: 'Mitigation timeline: 08:18 — throttles observed; 08:27 — autoscaler rollback and hotfix deployed; 08:43 — flows returned to normal; 09:05 — monitoring confirms stability. Owner: SRE (jamie) and Provisioning Eng (raj)'.

alex: Good. I'll add embeddable customer email snippet below (short). Use this for CS outbound.

alex: ```
Hi <Customer name>,

We want to let you know about an intermittent onboarding delay some customers experienced today (08:10–09:05 UTC). The issue affected a small number of new tenant webhook activations in EU and APAC and has been resolved. No customer data was lost.

What we did: deployed a hotfix to stabilize provisioning autoscaling and added extra monitoring.

What we’re offering: one week of priority onboarding support and a 10% credit for onboarding-related usage during the incident window.

If you’re still seeing issues, please reply to this message or open a support ticket and we’ll prioritize you.

— The Redwood Inference team
```

maria: That looks good. Add a small line for legal/compliance: 'If you need an official incident report for auditors, reply and we'll provide the full RCA with timestamps.'

emily: Translations requested. I'll get FR/DE/JA back in ~40 minutes. For APAC customers we may want localized office hours — I'll propose a late AM JST slot.

raj: CS routing: please tag accounts with "incident:onboarding-1749998000" and set high-touch priority for any flagged renewal customers. I'll push the credit adjustments once CS ops confirms the list.

alex: Small internal checklist before outbound: 1) Confirm impacted tenant list (maria) — in progress. 2) Legal signoff line added (maria) — done. 3) Translations (emily) — requested. 4) Credit dispatch (raj) — ready pending list. 5) Exec summary to sales & partnerships (alex) — sending after this thread.

sarah-bot: Incident alert: Monitoring resumed normal rates at 08:43 UTC, error rate <0.05% for last 20m.

maria: Impacted list attached in my doc (link). I'll export to CS queue and start targeted outreach to 18 flagged accounts — prioritizing renewal risk.

raj: FYI — postmortem owners: provisioning eng (raj), SRE (jamie), CS ops (maria). Target full RCA in 3 business days.

alex: Thanks team. I'll post final customer message + exec note in 15m and spin up an office hours invite for any partners who want a walkthrough. :thumbsup:

emily: If you want me to prep localized templates for CS, I'll drop them here when ready.

maria: Great work. Keeping outreach tight and transparent is the priority.

alex: Closing thread for live edits only. If you need changes, reply here.
